# Kansas Department of Commerce

> > Kansas Department of Commerce: The state's lead economic development agency driving business recruitment, workforce development, and strategic investments across key industries.

The Kansas Department of Commerce serves as the primary economic development authority for the state, promoting business expansion, workforce initiatives, and regional growth. The site showcases major corporate investments, manufacturing facilities, and strategic projects like the Kansas City Chiefs stadium development.

## Key Topics

- Economic Development
- Business Incentives
- Workforce Development
- Manufacturing & Clean Energy
- Regional Development
- Business Recruitment
- Apprenticeship Programs
- State Rankings
- Key Industries
- Infrastructure & Location
- Panasonic EV Battery
- Merck Animal Health
- Kansas City Chiefs
- Rural Development
- Business Resources

## Core Business Resources

- [Information and Resources for Business Recruitment and Development](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/businesses): Business recruitment and development resources for Kansas investment
- [Business Incentives and Financing in Kansas](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/businesses/incentives): Business incentives and financing programs in Kansas
- [Quick access to the entire U.S. market](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/businesses/location): Kansas geographic location and infrastructure advantages
- [State of Kansas Demographics](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/businesses/demographics): Kansas population demographics and workforce statistics
- [Grants Calendar](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/grantscalendar): Grants calendar and funding opportunities for businesses

## Workforce & Economic Development

- [Workforce](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/workforce): Workforce development and apprenticeship programs in Kansas
- [Regions](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/regions): Kansas regional economic development overview and key industries
- [Made in Kansas](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/made-in-kansas): Made in Kansas manufacturing and industry showcase
- [Living in Kansas](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/living): Quality of life and living opportunities in Kansas

## Strategic Projects & Investments

- [Kansas City Chiefs](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/chiefs): Kansas City Chiefs stadium and headquarters development project
- [Gov. Kelly and Kansas City Chiefs Announce Agreement On Plans for State-of-the-Art Domed Stadium in Kansas](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/2025/12/gov-kelly-and-kansas-city-chiefs-announce-agreement-on-plans-for-state-of-the-art-domed-stadium-in-kansas): Gov. Kelly announces Kansas City Chiefs domed stadium agreement
- [Governor Kelly Celebrates Grand Opening of Panasonic EV Battery Manufacturing Facility in De Soto](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/2025/07/governor-kelly-celebrates-grand-opening-of-panasonic-ev-battery-manufacturing-facility-in-de-soto): Panasonic EV battery manufacturing facility opening in De Soto
- [Merck Animal Health Investing $895M in De Soto Plant Expansion](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/2025/05/merck-animal-health-investing-895m-in-de-soto-plant-expansion): Merck Animal Health $895M De Soto plant expansion announcement
- [Governor Kelly Announces Grand Opening of Heartland Coca-Cola Olathe Production Campus](https://www.kansascommerce.gov/2025/06/governor-kelly-announces-grand-opening-of-heartland-coca-cola-olathe-production-campus): Heartland Coca-Cola production campus opening in Olathe
